name: Global Polynomial Energy Formulation
description: Replaces the explicit local inequality constraints (c_u != c_v) with a global energy function that sums a specific polynomial over all protocols. The polynomial evaluates to 0 for valid differences and 4 for invalid ones. Models that fail to mathematically analyze the polynomial's domain will not realize they can safely prune the search locally, leading them to write unpruned global searches that TLE.
